# Eater Seattle

> > Eater Seattle is the definitive guide to Seattle's restaurant scene, breweries, bars, and food culture in the Pacific Northwest.

Eater Seattle covers dining news, restaurant openings and closings, chef profiles, neighborhood dining guides, and the vibrant craft beverage scene across Seattle and the greater Puget Sound region. The site features venue profiles, dining maps, and coverage of Seattle's evolving culinary landscape from Ballard to Capitol Hill and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Ballard
- Seattle dining scene
- Brewery and taproom culture
- Yakima Valley brewing
- Bale Breaker Brewing Company
- Yonder Cider
- Populuxe Brewing
- Fresh Hop Ale Festival
- Coming attractions and restaurant openings
- Craft beverage collaborations
- Pacific Northwest food culture
- Seattle neighborhood dining guides

## Breweries & Taprooms

- [Bale Breaker Brewing Company](https://seattle.eater.com/venue/50307/bale-breaker-brewing-company): Venue profile for Bale Breaker Brewing taproom in Ballard
